The quality gate is not passed: the line-coverage gate is met for both components, but neither mutation score could be measured. I stopped the session at that point and recorded the shortfall as two decisions.

| Component | Line coverage | Mutation score |
|---|---|---|
| backend (all 610 tests pass) | 97.05 % (JaCoCo) | not measured, see D-63 |
| frontend (243 unit tests pass) | 95.63 % (unit only) | not measured, see D-64 |

- **Frontend coverage:** it was 93.99 % at the start of the session. I added 11 unit tests for the contact page and the duplicates tab to reach 95.63 %. The frontend figure counts unit tests only, so it is a lower bound for "all levels".
- **Backend JaCoCo:** the earlier "malformed input" report error came from a corrupt `target/jacoco.exec`. `mvn clean verify` fixed it, with no configuration change.
- **Backend mutation (D-63):** PIT ran 0 tests, so all 948 mutants counted as "no coverage". It needs `pitest-junit5-plugin`, which is not in `tech-stack.md`, so adding it needs your approval. I proposed approving it.
- **Frontend mutation (D-64):** Stryker was stopped at the 2-hour limit for a background command and wrote no report. I proposed running it outside the agent, or in slices of the same scope.

Commits: `7020545` (tests), `a5ec6cf` (the `build:` commit excluding the entry point from JaCoCo and PIT), and `6a6b41a` (docs and handover). The unrelated `springdoc` change in `pom.xml` (F-06) is still uncommitted.

Next is `/quality-gate D-63: 1`, once you have answered D-63 and D-64; the answers go into the decisions log.
